marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to light Friday
morning. Scattered flurries. Fog patches dissipating this
morning. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
this afternoon then subsiding to 1 or less near noon Friday.<br/>
